# I Have a Meeting

> Find, claim, fix, verify, and integrate the most important available issue before a shared deadline.

- [Skill](i-have-a-meeting/SKILL.md): Complete instructions; the only installation payload.
- [README](README.md): Installation and usage.

When asked to install, resolve the skill link relative to this file. Save it as `i-have-a-meeting/SKILL.md` in the user's skill directory. For Codex, use `~/.agents/skills/` for personal use or `.agents/skills/` in the target project for shared use. Preserve the contents and verify the copy. Follow the user's update instructions if an existing copy differs. Installation does not run the skill.

Invoke `$i-have-a-meeting` with an optional natural-language focus and deadline. The default is 30 minutes. Multiple workers inherit the same focus, deadline, and shared coordination state; the skill does not start workers itself.
